cc:Work.dc:description: State order follows the checked-in latent-state catalog; names, probabilities, payoff matrices, and pure/mixed equilibria are in metric_atlas.json. Negative boundaries mean the target action already beats the alternative in that comparison. Strict dominance requires > the boundary. Protocol belief percentages and utility payoff gaps use different units; neutral bonuses do not select a unique protocol.
